messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired — PD-8472 — service: inference-runtime-eu — symptom: 5xx spike on /v1/generate — severity: P2 — runbook: /runbooks/inference-5xx :rotating_light:

pagerbot: Details: recent deploy=ml-deploy-batch-23@2026-03-14T11:58Z, suggested actions: roll back canary, check model-worker OOMs, consider fallback policy. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/8472

maya (oncall): Acked. I'm on it. Pulling dashboards and logs now. :raised_hand:

devin: I'm online — ping me with what you see. Any customer impact yet?

carla: Looking at prometheus: 5xx rate jumped from ~0.3% -> ~12% across eu-west-1 around 12:02 UTC. Errors are mostly 502 from model-worker pool. Top error lines from worker logs: ```
2026-03-14T12:02:41Z level=error service=model-worker req_id=5f2a... status=502 err="oom: killed process"
2026-03-14T12:03:10Z level=error service=model-worker req_id=7a3b... status=502 err="oom: failed allocate"
```

darren: I see autoscaler attempted a scale-up then route fallback kicked in per policy: traffic split moved -> eu fallback to us-west for ~30% traffic. That explains mixed latency. I'm checking if fallback threshold was too aggressive.

maya (oncall): Can we pause canary or rollback ml-deploy-batch-23? Who pushed that deploy? @devin? :thinking_face:

devin: I pushed the canary. I rolled the canary back ~2m ago via console, but 5xxs are still elevated. Stack traces point to LRU cache eviction leading to memory blowouts in the C++ worker. Suspect recent cache tuning change.

carla: Confirming OOM traces and consistent GC churn. Heap size spikes right before kill. Example tail from crashed container: ```
#0 0x7f... in allocate
#1 0x6a... in kv_cache::insert
#2 0x4b... in model_infer::forward
"oom: failed allocate"
```

darren: I'm executing rollback commands for the cache flag and scaling the worker pool up by +4 to buy time: ```
redwood infra set worker.cache_enabled=false --env=eu-west-1
redwood infra scale workers --service=model-worker --count=+4 --region=eu-west-1
```

pagerbot: Auto-scaler action: +4 workers requested. Status: in-progress. ETA ~90s.

sre-bot: NOTE: route-fallback policy engaged. Current traffic split: eu-west-1=70%, us-west-2=30%.

maya (oncall): Customer impact: support triage shows ~8 production customers with intermittent failures on generation. CS is being notified. @customer-success please push a status update to status.redwood.ai with the P2 note.

customer-success: Acknowledged. Drafting status page update now — sending to legal for review, will publish in ~10m. DMing the top 3 impacted customers with a heads-up.

devin: Rollback of cache flag applied. I'm watching worker logs and memory metrics. If OOMs stop, we can gradually shift traffic back and keep an eye on error budget.

carla: After rollback + scale, 5xx dropped to ~1.1% after 3m. Latency stable. Correlates with memory graphs — OOMs stopped at ~12:07 UTC.

darren: I'm going to adjust fallback threshold to avoid aggressive cross-region fallback in short lived spikes: `redwood config set routing.fallback_threshold=10% --env=prod` — doing now.

pagerbot: PagerDuty update: owner set to devin, status=investigating. PD link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/8472/alerts

maya (oncall): Good progress. Please keep 1-min pings. If error rate stays <2% for 10m we can close page after postmortem plan.

devin: 1-min update: 5xx at 0.9%, no new OOMs in last 4m. I've opened PR to revert the cache-tuning change and added an integration test to catch regressive memory growth: https://git.example/r/redwood/infra/pulls/768

carla: I'll add a metrics alert for heap-growth > 70% baseline to avoid silent regressions.

darren: Follow-ups: (1) revert cache tuning permanently until we have memory-safe telemetry, (2) tune fallback policy to 10% threshold, (3) postmortem. I'll file the follow-up tasks in the incident board.

maya (oncall): Customer impact note: support notified, status page published. Thanks all.

devin: Marking PD incident as mitigated. Will own postmortem writeup and link the PR.

incident-bot: PD-8472 status changed -> RESOLVED (mitigated) by devin. Closing thread in 30m unless any objections. :white_check_mark:

maya (oncall): No objections. Moving to follow-up. Great quick teamwork.

carla: Creating the postmortem skeleton now and assigning owners.

sre-bot: Reminder: include timeline, impact table (customers, error rates), root cause (LRU cache regression), corrective actions, and detection/response metrics.

devin: I'll draft the postmortem and link PR + deploy notes. Tagging @carla and @darren as reviewers.

customer-success: I'll follow up with impacted customers with the resolution note and ETA for a permanent fix.

maya (oncall): Closing ping: last 5xx rate steady at 0.7% for 10m. If nothing changes, I'll close PD and this thread at 13:00 UTC. Thanks everyone. :tada:
